text: My daily routine is built around consistency, which helps me stay productive. I wake up at six-thirty each morning and start with a glass of water and a short meditation session. After a quick breakfast, I’m at my desk by eight, where I focus on work tasks until noon. In the afternoon, I take a thirty-minute walk or do a quick workout to recharge. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, and planning the next day. I try to go to bed by ten-thirty. This simple schedule keeps me balanced and ready for whatever comes.
